title: The Diversification Doctrine
dek: Why spreading investments across geographies and sectors protects personal wealth — and why nations that concentrate their economies in one commodity or one customer pay the same price for concentration, only larger.

How the 2026 US–Iran war, Red Sea attacks and a sanctions war on Russian energy travelled through the world's shipping chokepoints into oil and gas prices — and from there into inflation, interest rates and growth forecasts.
title: When Wars Move Markets
